title: Smoked Salmon Grilled Skewers
description: A delicious and easy-to-make appetizer or snack featuring smoky salmon, grilled to perfection. Perfect for a summer evening.

ingredients.name: Norwegian Yogurt
ingredients.notes: add a tangy and creamy element to the dish

ingredients.name: Exotic Fruit Salsa (such as mango, pineapple, and kiwi)
ingredients.notes: add a burst of flavor and color to the dish

ingredients.name: Grill Skewers
ingredients.notes: make sure the skewers are long enough to hold the salmon fillets

ingredients.name: Olive Oil
ingredients.notes: use a high-quality, extra-virgin olive oil for the best flavor

ingredients.name: Lemon Juice
ingredients.notes: add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice for extra brightness

ingredients.name: Garlic Powder
ingredients.notes: use a light hand when adding garlic powder, as it can be overpowering

ingredients.name: Salt and Pepper
ingredients.notes: season the salmon to taste, but be mindful of the delicate flavor of the smoked salmon

instructions: 1. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
2. In a small bowl, whisk together the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
3. Place the salmon fillets on the grill skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
4. Brush the salmon with the olive oil mixture, making sure each piece is coated.
5. Grill the salmon for 2-3 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
6. Serve the grilled salmon on a platter or individual plates, topped with the exotic fruit salsa and a dollop of Norwegian yogurt.
